units.account: Col. Aubry reads his order literally: he is already drawn up in line a short way south of the river, facing the bridge, which is a good position near the river, so he stays put and dresses his line. About the enemy, he will deal with them as he sees fit once they appear. He sights a column on the road at the end of the turn but it is still beyond range.
Col. Delacroix has no new order and keeps his line beside the 1st Battalion, watching the far bank. He sees an enemy column approach on the road and waits to see what it does.
Maj. Verneuil has no new order and stays behind the infantry. He sees an enemy column come down the road at the end of the turn, and champs at the bit but does not move without orders.
Col. Brandt has no new order and holds his position, though he would like to advance. He sees nothing of the enemy.

Col. Hartmann gets 'Push on' at about the third minute. It names no place, so he does the plain thing by the book: forms column and advances south, bearing towards the high road, in the direction he was already facing. He moves about a kilometre and, with no objective and an enemy line in sight, halts short of the river and awaits further orders.
units.departure: Projection holds red-2 at (2250,150), having no order but 'hold'. The order 'Push on' arrived at minute 3 and is read as an instruction to advance south, so the unit marches about 1000 m, well over the 100 m tolerance.

units.account: Maj. von Reiter has no new order and stays where he is, though he is restless. He sees nothing of the enemy.

summary: Turn 1 was quiet. Blue-1 was told to take a good position near the river; being already in line a short way south of it, he stayed where he was. Red-2 received the order 'Push on', which names no objective, and Col. Hartmann advanced about a kilometre south in column towards the high road, halting short of the river. The other Red units had no orders and held. At the end of the turn the Red column was in sight of the Blue infantry and cavalry, but no fire was exchanged. This differs from the projection only in the movement of red-2.
